title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover + load-shedding hysteresis
author: Aisha Patel
description: Urgent hotfix: under sustained cross-region load we observed the SLO enforcer triggering circuit-breaker failover and load-shedding repeatedly (thrashing) which caused request amplification and temporary capacity collapse. Root cause summary: a rare ordering race between the per-region failover decision and the global backoff/hysteresis timer caused rapid toggling when region latencies were near the threshold. Fix: reorder decision logic so backoff/hysteresis wins and add an explicit per-request admission token check to avoid double-counting in the shed path. Also tightened the load-shedding thresholds and added smoothing to the regional health score to avoid reacting to short spikes. This PR includes code fixes, unit and e2e tests, metrics/alert updates, and a small chart values change for safer defaults. Impact: restores stable regional failover behavior, reduces failover churn, reduces unnecessary load-shedding and avoids cascades. Rollout: merged to main and backported to release/2026-02 (release PR will follow). Related tickets: ENG-3421 diagnosis and ENG-3429 follow-up for dashboarding.

review_conversation: Ravi Singh: Found a race in the earlier implementation where the region failover mutation and the global backoff timer could interleave. Can you add a deterministic test that reproduces the ordering?

Aisha Patel: Added unit test that advances timers deterministically and an e2e scenario that simulates a 200ms jitter spike across the region cluster. The deterministic test is in hysteresis_test.go and uses injectClock for fast-path validation.
Lena Park: Agree with the ordering change, but suggest we expose the smoothing window as a chart value with safer defaults. Updated values.yaml accordingly.
Diego Martinez: CI flakes on first run due to test timing; reran and all green, verified prometheus metrics emitted for 'slo_enforcer.failover_count' and 'slo_enforcer.shed_rate' increments.
Ravi Singh: Approved pending one nit about an error message (fixed).

testing_notes: Added deterministic clock-based unit tests and an integration harness scenario that replays real incident traces. Manual soak run executed on staging for 4 hours with synthetic cross-region spikes; no failover churn observed. Prometheus metrics validated and alert thresholds adjusted.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover and reduce load-shedding thrashing. No API changes. Operators: consider backport to active release branches and monitor 'slo_enforcer.failover_count' metric.
operator_runbook_snippet: If you observe repeated regional failovers: 1) check slo_enforcer.failover_count for spike patterns 2) verify chart value 'sloEnforcer.smoothingWindowMs' is >= 500 3) if thrashing persists, set 'sloEnforcer.forceRegionalBackoff=true' and open SUP ticket.
notes_for_followup: Follow-up tasks: dashboarding work (ENG-3429) to surface regional hysteresis windows and per-region health score; consider adaptive smoothing in a future change; schedule backport PR to release/2026-02 once CI passes on branch.
